task: T4: add the launcher and the wiring to scripts/dispatch/dispatcher.py. Define `launch(job, *, runner=None)` which serialises the Job dict to JSON and applies it by running an external command, reading the command name from the environment variable `HARNESS_KUBECTL` and defaulting to the literal `kubectl`; pass the JSON on the command's standard input with arguments `apply -f -`. Return the command's exit status. It must not raise when the command is missing — report the failure and return non-zero. Then define `handle_event(text, event_id, *, ledger_path, image, namespace)` which performs the whole flow in order: parse the intent; if there is none, return without launching anything; if the event id is already in the ledger, return without launching anything; otherwise render the Job, launch it, record the event id, and return a small result mapping saying what happened. The order is load-bearing — a message that does not parse must never reach the launcher, and an event already actioned must never launch a second time. Do not add retry logic, do not call a verify script, and do not import any model client: every judgment belongs to the worker, and this file must stay small enough to read in one sitting.
